summary: The team is juggling the urgent China Going-Global report launch in Singapore, SEO prioritization of Asia Star and Intelligent China, and a knowledge website redesign, with multiple deliverables due this week.
summaryDetail: The top priority is the China Going-Global report (working title 'The New Chinese Playbook for Going Global'), a joint CKGSB-IE project launching at Tech in Asia or Tyson event in Singapore mid-September. Urgent this week: editing chapter 4, sending Dean Haitao's article, finalizing op-ed contributors (President Santiago, Dean from IE), and securing industry case studies from alumni. Separately, the SEO strategy is shifting focus to Asia Star and Intelligent China programs, deprioritizing US partnerships; Joseph needs to provide Google Ads conversion tracking brief and target audience profiles. The knowledge website redesign is merging Joker's and Joseph's designs to display more articles and indices, with feedback due from Julie. Other open items include expediting social media agency selection (Media Minds preferred), revising the Shun Tian Shu press release, and creating a publication page for Professor Zhu Rui's book. Upcoming: Tech in Asia collaboration needs Shouhuo's approval before PO, and the EV event speaker list prioritizes Mats Harborn from Traton.

decisions.text: Videos will not have their own category; they will be dispersed by topic due to being out of date.
The knowledge website redesign will incorporate elements from both Joker's and Joseph's designs, focusing on showing more articles and indices.
Asia Star and Intelligent China are top priority programs for marketing.
US partnerships (Berkeley, Stanford, Columbia) will be deprioritized initially; Berkeley may be considered as a third priority.
SEO strategy will focus on matching website content to search queries like 'AI in China', 'EVs in China', 'smart manufacturing in China'.
Only one press release for Shun Tian Shu, either incorporating 10 points or turning into 10-point article.
Zhu Yang's feedback is not actionable; will not spend excessive time on it.
Media Minds is preferred social media agency due to budget constraints and time sensitivity.
Report will be jointly published by CKGSB and IE, jointly distributed.
Working title: 'The New Chinese Playbook for Going Global'.
Report to be ready by early September for Singapore events.
Report will include main research by Professor Leeway, op-eds from leadership, and industry case studies.
Approved the new program title for the Indonesia Emerging Market program as suggested by Joseph.
